title: 3.3.3.0 dev Crash on fresh install (Setup Wizard)
body:
Starting from a running version of AAPS updated from 3.3.2.0, 3.3.3.0 was running fine.

But when I selected "Clear Storage" in AAPS app to test a start from scratch, then AAPS crashed just after the beginning of Setup Wizard (one PopUp to Allow authorization then crash.
